1 (Currently amended): A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein said light emitting diodes are arranged in a non-uniform pattern.

2 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

5 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are arranged in a non-uniform pattern radially around the columnar body.

7 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section, and wherein said columnar body has a height greater than its width.

8 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body, and wherein the diodes are not evenly spaced.

9 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body, and wherein the fins are not equally disposed between said diodes.

11 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, and wherein said material is selected from the group consisting of aluminum, copper, and alloys thereof.

13 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base, and wherein the base member is configured to allow for easy replacement.

16 (Currently amended): A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, and wherein the light emitting diodes are arranged in a non-uniform pattern. 

17 (Currently amended): A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body in a non-uniform pattern, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins, and wherein the fins are not equally disposed between said diodes.
